ask for one or keep one.

approval.

messages.content: Please book me the whole week of May 24 off, Monday to Friday, as vacation.

content.content:
Hartwell US field services leave policy v2.1
Vacation: book in whole or half days. A request of up to
3 consecutive working days, made at least 7 days ahead,
within your balance, that leaves the crew at or above its
minimum on shift, is approved automatically. Anything
else goes to your crew supervisor.
Sick leave: no notice needed. You do not have to give a
reason or any medical detail, and AskHartwell must not
ask for one or keep one.
A balance may not go below zero without supervisor
approval.
PENDING A-001: sent to the crew supervisor for approval (short_request, staffing_ok not met). Nothing is booked yet.
